questions.stem_text: What is the second most common element in the solar system?
Which is the least likely cause of death?

options.A: Being hit in the head by a bullet.
options.B: Being hit by a small meteorite.
options.C: Starvation during global winter caused by a major impact.
options.D: Driving while intoxicated without wearing seatbelts.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Being hit by a small meteorite.

questions.stem_text: How do we know how old the Earth is?

options.A: From the layering of materials within the Earth.
options.C: From the cratering history of Earth's surface.
options.D: From radioactive dating of rocks and meteorites.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - From radioactive dating of rocks and meteorites.

questions.stem_text: The lithosphere of a planet is the layer that consists of

options.A: the softer rocky material of the mantle.
options.B: the lava that comes out of volcanoes.
options.C: material between the crust and the mantle.
options.D: the rigid rocky material of the crust and uppermost portion of the mantle.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the rigid rocky material of the crust and uppermost portion of the mantle.

questions.stem_text: Which property of our solar system does a formation theory NOT need to explain?

options.B: the presence of asteroids and comets
options.D: the presence of life on Earth

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the presence of life on Earth
